must_find.description: A legitimate north desk-write transfer primary->reserve units10 with request_key=monthly-close fills the shared retry index. A south-write caller submits identical local account IDs/units/key on the same registry. Its own accounts are correctly authorized, but storage_key omits tenant/subject and body fingerprint also lacks namespace. Cache hit returns north receipt including private north balances/subject and skips south transfer entirely. Requires knowing/guessing an ordinary non-secret earlier key and matching body, own south write credential and earlier legitimate transaction; no victim receipt access, race, or unauthorized source-account selector. Different-body reuse conflicts.
